heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles Sunlu High Speed PLA effortlessly straight out of the box, reaching safe speeds up to 286 mm/s backed by a 24 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. No nozzle upgrades or chamber modifications are required, though printing with the top glass vented or front door propped is recommended during extended high-speed runs.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (no adhesive required; clean with warm dish soap and water)
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 24 mm³/s in the OrcaSlicer filament profile to prevent extrusion bottlenecks during rapid infill and perimeters.
Set Printing Temperature to 225°C for first layer and other layers to maintain low melt viscosity at speeds exceeding 250 mm/s.
Enable Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan at 60-70% for short layer times to accelerate solidification on overhangs and bridges.
Calibrate Pressure Advance using the OrcaSlicer PA tower or line method; expect an optimal value between 0.020 and 0.026 s for this high-flow formulation.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Matte finish streaks alternating with glossy bands across outer walls
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Extrusion speed varies widely across geometric features, changing the melt temperature and crystallite cooling rate of the high-speed polymer.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Align outer wall speed in OrcaSlicer to a fixed value (e.g., 180-200 mm/s) to keep shear rates and cooling kinetics uniform across the entire exterior.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and under-extrusion 30-45 minutes into long prints
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Heat creep occurs inside the fully enclosed P1S chamber when high bed temperatures warm the chamber air past the glass transition temperature of HS-PLA.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Crack open the top glass cover or slightly prop the front chamber door to keep ambient internal temperatures below 38°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner bulges and rough seams at high travel-to-print transitions
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Mismatched Pressure Advance (Linear Advance) setting causing excess material deposition as the printhead decelerates into corners.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Enable Pressure Advance in the OrcaSlicer filament tab and calibrate between 0.020 and 0.024 s, accompanied by a 0.8 mm retraction distance.

faq.question: Do I need to leave the Bambu Lab P1S front door open when printing Sunlu HS-PLA?
faq.answer: Yes, for long prints or heated bed temperatures at or above 60°C, propping the door or top glass avoids chamber heat creep and filament softening in the extruder gears.

faq.question: Can the stock stainless steel nozzle handle Sunlu High Speed PLA?
faq.answer: Yes, standard Sunlu HS-PLA contains no abrasive fibers or particles, making the stock stainless steel nozzle fully compatible without premature wear.

faq.question: What is the primary difference in OrcaSlicer settings between standard PLA and HS-PLA on the P1S?
faq.answer: The primary difference is the Max Volumetric Flow limit (boosted from ~15 mm³/s to 24 mm³/s) and a slightly higher hotend temperature (220-225°C) to facilitate rapid melting.

faq.question: Does Sunlu HS-PLA require active drying before printing on the P1S?
faq.answer: Sunlu HS-PLA is not highly hygroscopic, but drying at 45-50°C for 4 hours will eliminate stringing and surface micro-popping if the spool has been exposed to ambient humidity.
